cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t valid
cases.expected: All nine bootstrap variables pass and parsed types are correct.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t missing DATABASE_URL
cases.expected: EnvConfigError reports DATABASE_URL in missing.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t two missing
cases.expected: One error reports both missing names.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t mysql
cases.expected: DATABASE_URL is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t AUTH_SECRET
cases.expected: 31-character auth secret is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t 31-byte
cases.expected: 31-byte encryption key is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t 32-byte
cases.expected: 32-byte encryption key passes.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t TRUE
cases.expected: Uppercase AI_MOCK is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t API key required
cases.expected: False mock mode requires a non-empty API key.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t mock optional
cases.expected: True mock mode permits an empty API key.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t http
cases.expected: HTTP AI_BASE_URL is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t timeout
cases.expected: Non-integer and sub-1000 timeout values are invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t cost limit
cases.expected: Zero cost limit is invalid.

cases.command: npm run test -- src/lib/env.test.ts -t registry
cases.expected: Example keys exactly match the nine eligible registry keys and domain rules.

cases.command: npm run lint; npm run format:check; npm run test; npm run typecheck; npm run build; npm run verify:phase003
cases.expected: All quality commands exit zero.

cases.command: isolated mutation removes DATABASE_URL validation then npm run test
cases.expected: Tests fail on missing database cases, then source is restored.

cases.command: isolated mutation throws on first error then npm run test
cases.expected: Two-missing-variable test fails, then source is restored.

cases.command: isolated mutation removes 32-byte check then npm run test
cases.expected: 31-byte encryption test fails, then source is restored.

cases.command: isolated mutation removes false-mode API key check then npm run test
cases.expected: False-mode empty-key test fails, then source is restored.

cases.command: isolated mutation adds a key to .env.example then npm run test
cases.expected: Registry projection test fails, then source is restored.

cases.command: isolated .env.local mutation followed by npm run dev
cases.expected: Startup exits with EnvConfigError naming DATABASE_URL and does not serve the page.

cases.command: npm run dev; curl.exe -s -o NUL -w %{http_code} http://localhost:3000/
cases.expected: Restored environment serves HTTP 200.

cases.command: git status --porcelain; git check-ignore -v .env.local
cases.expected: Local environment is ignored and .env.example remains trackable.
